name: frc5805-backup
description: The nightly backup of the FRC Team 5805 portal: Firebase -> backup host -> second machine. Installed on the backup host only; the site does not depend on it.

scripts.test:emulators: cd ../.. && npx firebase --config firebase.backup-test.json emulators:exec --project demo-frc5805 "node scripts/backup/test/roundtrip.test.mjs && node scripts/backup/test/repo-archive.test.mjs"
